foundation_source:
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Defs

namespace LMS.Foundation

universe v

structure Category where
  Obj : Type (v+1)
  Hom : Obj → Obj → Type v
  id : (x : Obj) → Hom x x
  comp : {x y z : Obj} → Hom x y → Hom y z → Hom x z

structure Functor (C D : Category.{v}) where
  obj : C.Obj → D.Obj
  map : {x y : C.Obj} → C.Hom x y → D.Hom (obj x) (obj y)

structure NatTrans {C D : Category.{v}} (F G : Functor C D) where
  component : (x : C.Obj) → D.Hom (F.obj x) (G.obj x)

def TypeCat : Category.{v} where
  Obj := Type v
  Hom := fun X Y => X → Y
  id := fun _ x => x
  comp := fun f g x => g (f x)

def homFunctor (C : Category.{v}) (X : C.Obj) : Functor C TypeCat.{v} where
  obj := fun Y => C.Hom X Y
  map := fun f g => C.comp g f

end LMS.Foundation
